The three state bodies and four helpers keep their func_ov098_* linker names as C-linkage helpers over daWbm_c *. The states are called through the table as members of this class, but a member spelling would coin seven mangled names; that rename is left to a separate change.

MEASURED: func_ov098_0213b6e0 tests actorID through an int flag before branching; spelled as a plain `if (actorID == 0xbf) ... else if (actorID == 0xce)` it DIFFs (13/14). func_ov098_0213b9d8 keeps its arithmetic one step per statement; folding the lead computation into one expression DIFFs by 7 words (13/14).

MEASURED: the TU includes common.h before the class header so the flat Matrix4x3 spelling wins; with math/Matrix.h's {Matrix3x3, Vector3} spelling the two matrix copies in func_ov098_0213b584 become memberwise and the function grows from 0xb8 to 0xec bytes.

dCcAc_c::Init, dBgCh_Actr::Init, dActor_c::DropShadowRadHeight, Player::Hurt and Particle::System::NewSimple stay mangled: each takes Fix12<int> by value (wall 6az). ModelBase::SetFile stays mangled because include/ModelBase.h declares it void and InitResources reads its int result.

Header fields named in this change (mShadowMat, mSpawnPosX/Y/Z, mBounceCount, mSquashSpeed, mSquashScale, mBouncePhase, mState, mVariant) are inferred from the bodies; the offsets and types are proven by the bytes, the English names are not.
